Lee · Listen & Shadow 16

The Week Ahead — this weekend, and the week after
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
SCENE 1 · FRIDAY AFTERNOON — THE WEEKEND
👤 Brian
So — any plans for the weekend?
자, 이번 주말에 뭐 계획 있어요?
💬 Lee
I'm thinking of driving somewhere outside Seoul.
서울 밖으로 드라이브 갈까 생각 중이에요.
drive — 운전해서 가다 · outside ~ — ~ 밖으로
같은 패턴으로 — I'm thinking of changing the samples. · I'm thinking of learning to swim. · I'm thinking of moving closer to the office.
👤 Brian
Nice. Where to?
좋네요. 어디로요?
💬 Lee
If the weather holds, we'll go to the river.
날씨만 받쳐주면 강가로 가려고요.
hold — (날씨가) 유지되다, 버티다 · river — 강
같은 패턴으로 — If the weather holds, we'll eat outside. · If the weather holds, the trip is on. · If the weather holds, I'll wash the car.
💬 Lee
If it rains, I might just stay in and sleep.
비 오면 그냥 집에서 잘지도 몰라요.
stay in — 집에 있다 · just — 그냥
같은 패턴으로 — I might just order chicken. · I might just skip the gym today. · I might just send it by email.
👤 Brian
Fair enough. Anything already fixed?
그럴 만하죠. 이미 정해진 건 있어요?
💬 Lee
We're supposed to have dinner with my parents on Sunday.
일요일에 부모님이랑 저녁 먹기로 돼 있어요.
be supposed to — ~하기로 되어 있다 · parents — 부모님
같은 패턴으로 — We're supposed to ship it on Friday. · I'm supposed to pick her up at seven. · They're supposed to call us back.
💬 Lee
Honestly, I could use a quiet weekend.
솔직히 조용한 주말이 절실해요.
could use ~ — ~가 아쉽다, ~가 절실하다 · quiet — 조용한
같은 패턴으로 — I could use a coffee. · We could use one more designer. · She could use some sleep.
👤 Brian
You've earned it.
그럴 자격 있어요.
SCENE 2 · AND NEXT WEEK AT WORK
👤 Brian
And next week — what does it look like?
그럼 다음 주는 어때요?
💬 Lee
Next week is all about the new projector model.
다음 주는 온통 새 프로젝터 모델이에요.
all about ~ — 온통 ~ 중심인 · projector — 프로젝터
같은 패턴으로 — This month is all about the trade show. · Today is all about cleaning. · The trip is all about food.
💬 Lee
I have three meetings lined up.
미팅이 세 개 잡혀 있어요.
lined up — 줄줄이 잡혀 있는 · meeting — 회의
같은 패턴으로 — I have two calls lined up. · We have three interviews lined up. · She has a whole weekend lined up.
👤 Brian
Three? Which one matters most?
세 개요? 제일 중요한 건 뭐예요?
💬 Lee
The big one is the meeting with the Singapore buyer.
제일 큰 건 싱가포르 바이어 미팅이에요.
buyer — 구매자, 바이어 · matter — 중요하다
같은 패턴으로 — The big one is Thursday. · The big one is the final test. · The big one is my mom's birthday.
💬 Lee
I need to get the samples done by Wednesday.
수요일까지 샘플을 끝내야 해요.
get ~ done — ~를 끝내다 · sample — 샘플
같은 패턴으로 — I need to get the report done by Friday. · I need to get the laundry done by tonight. · We need to get the room done by noon.
👤 Brian
That's tight.
빠듯한데요.
💬 Lee
It is. But if the samples go well, we'll sign this month.
그렇죠. 근데 샘플이 잘 나오면 이번 달에 계약해요.
tight — 빠듯한 · sign — 계약하다, 서명하다
같은 패턴으로 — If the test goes well, we'll launch in May. · If tonight goes well, I'll ask her out again. · If the call goes well, they'll visit us.
👤 Brian
Then let's talk again next Friday.
그럼 다음 주 금요일에 또 얘기해요.
💬 Lee
Deal. I'll tell you how it went.
좋아요. 어떻게 됐는지 알려드릴게요.
느리게 19/19 · 보통 19/19
